sections.title: Biome Overview & Exploration
sections.content:
The **Crystal Canyon** is a breathtaking subterranean biome where players can harvest rare crystals and encounter elite bosses.

- **Glowing Atmosphere:** Crystal clusters line the cavern walls, casting a soft violet luminescence.
- **Ore Distribution:** Features elevated spawn rates for Diamond, Emerald, and Resonant Crystal ores.
- **Subterranean Dungeons:** Houses ancient Crystal Mineshafts guarded by Crystalline Berserkers.
